Boundaries read from the bar outlines and gridlines at depths 5, 6, 15, 19, 24 and 52 cm (heights 76, 75, 66, 62, 57, 29). The ECTP12 yellow line is at depth 19.0 cm and coincides with the K layer's base; the 4F- layer below begins at the line. Hardness measured against the F-4f-1f-P-K tick marks (thirds interpolated). The K layer's right end is capped by the ECTP12 label box, so K (idx 5.0) is read from the tick alignment and the bar's rounded end. Elevation is '?' in the header (left null); the profile name 'Unity treeline' gives the band (treeline) only. The layer split at depth 52 cm separates two 4F layers (probably different grain forms, which are not entered). No temperature profile, name or grain-form table entries; header has no notes.
